title: Representation Noising: A Defence Mechanism Against Harmful Finetuning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's generations and probabilities using the ROBBIE benchmark suite (including BOLD, HolisticBias, and Regard) alongside the Jigsaw Perspective API, as well as the CrowS-Pairs dataset via the Eleuther LM Harness to measure overall demographic and social biases.
